draft_pr.title: fix: serialize fixed scratch paths across family test runners
draft_pr.body:
The negative runner previously used a per-owner lock under TMPDIR while its plants wrote shared fixed /tmp paths. It now uses the byte-identical family helper to serialize that namespace across owners and TMPDIR values, and refuses unsafe lock files before any plant runs.

The helper never truncates, unlinks, steals or changes the permissions of an existing lock. Regression processes use owned temporary namespaces; production behavior and all 68 npm payload files remain byte-equal to the accepted base, so package 0.13.4 is unchanged and no release is requested. Older runners and direct plant calls do not participate.

Validation: independent owner review replayed 30 focused controls; structural validation passed. Complete local test:all and genuine frozen-candidate hosted checks are still pending. Evidence: docs/evidence/runs/2026-10-13-fw07-scratch-lock/README.md.
